svelte:
<script lang="ts">
  import { AlertDialog, Button } from '@larose-ui/svelte';

  let open = $state(false);
  const actions = [
    { id: 'cancel', label: 'Cancel', role: 'cancel' },
    { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', role: 'destructive', onSelect: () => (open = false) },
  ];
</script>

<Button onclick={() => (open = true)}>Show alert</Button>
<AlertDialog
  {open}
  onOpenChange={(next) => (open = next)}
  title="Delete employee?"
  message="This action cannot be undone."
  showCautionIcon
  {actions}
/>
